# OrbitCubs CRM

> A focused, free-tier CRM for small teams and solo operators. Contacts, leads,
> opportunities, accounts, cases, products, quotes, orders, activities, a
> knowledge base, dashboards, and reports — built client-side on free-tier
> Firebase (no paid backend functions), packaged for Android with Capacitor,
> and paired with a companion browser extension for quick capture from any page.
> Built and maintained by Ahsan Mahmood (https://aoneahsan.com).

## Status

OrbitCubs CRM is in active development (version 0.1.0). There is no public app
store listing yet; this documentation describes the product and its shipped
feature areas honestly. Six advanced modules ship today (AI chatbot, predictive
lead scoring, email automation, calendar sync, churn prediction, push
notifications); a further set of advanced modules have service scaffolding but
no UI yet.

- [Introduction](https://orbitcubs-docs.aoneahsan.com/): What OrbitCubs CRM is and who it's for.
- [Quick Start](https://orbitcubs-docs.aoneahsan.com/getting-started/quick-start): Run the app locally.

- [Architecture](https://orbitcubs-docs.aoneahsan.com/architecture): Stack, offline-first design, and zero-cost constraints.
